purpose: Test whether the fifteenth-century Sienese technical model-book group shows stronger evidence of composite/open-ended manuscript production than matched contemporary technical-manuscript controls.
technical_controls: Roberto Valturio, De re militari, BSB bsb00065289
antecedent_context_not_in_primary_test: BSB Clm 197 II (Taccola autograph, De ingeneis I-II)
BNCF Palatino 766 (Taccola autograph, De ingeneis III-IV)

coding_variables.V1_multiple_codicological_units: 1 if catalogue/codicological study explicitly identifies multiple independently formed units, fascicles, booklets, or materially distinct constituent parts; else 0; unknown if source insufficient.
coding_variables.V2_open_ended_addition_revision: 1 if source explicitly documents later additions, inserted leaves/fascicles, continuing annotation, rearrangement, or prolonged accretion during working life; else 0; unknown if source insufficient.
coding_variables.V3_multiple_hands_or_practitioner_layers: 1 if source explicitly documents multiple scribal/drawing hands or materially separable practitioner layers within the original/early production history; else 0; unknown if source insufficient.
coding_variables.V4_irregular_gathering_structure: 1 if source explicitly reports irregular, non-uniform, composite, singleton/singulion-rich, or otherwise exceptional gathering structure; else 0; unknown if source insufficient.
coding_variables.V5_copy_model_workbook_function: 1 if scholarship explicitly interprets manuscript as model book, copybook, workshop/practitioner reference volume, or evolving practical repertoire; else 0.
coding_variables.V6_independent_folio_stack_claim: 1 only if a scholarly source explicitly states or argues that the manuscript originated as unbound/independent folios or sheets before binding; inferred absence is 0; unknown if not addressed.

primary_endpoint.name: open_composite_production
primary_endpoint.definition: positive if at least two of V1,V2,V3,V4 are 1; V5 and V6 are reported separately and do not define the primary endpoint.
primary_endpoint.test: two-sided Fisher exact test comparing target vs technical-control manuscript counts

secondary_endpoints: sum of V1-V4 per manuscript (0-4), descriptive only
leave-one-manuscript-out sensitivity of primary Fisher result
anti_circularity: Do not code from Voynich literature or similarity claims.
Do not infer physical structure from visual resemblance.
Do not convert absence of discussion into a positive or negative physical claim unless the coding definition permits it.
Do not count multiple folios/pages as independent observations.
Palatino 766 is excluded from the primary target group because its disputed production history generated the hypothesis.
The Layfield-Davis Voynich singulion result is not used to define or classify the target/control manuscripts.

decision_rule.strong_support: target risk difference >=0.50 and Fisher p<=0.05, with direction preserved under every evaluable leave-one-out target deletion
decision_rule.moderate_support: target risk difference >=0.40 but strong-support rule not met
decision_rule.weak_or_unresolved: risk difference <0.40 or source incompleteness prevents >=4 evaluable manuscripts per group
